product_context.name: Streamer Highlight Analyzer
product_context.description: A web-based application to identify, score, and manage gaming stream highlights.

needs: Ability to filter and sort highlights by game, category, or score.
Exportable highlight lists for editing or sharing.
Efficient tools to locate and extract key moments.
Support for manual tagging and adjustments.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.responsibility: Overview of imported streams and detected highlights.

screens.name: Highlight Viewer
screens.responsibility: Detailed view of detected highlights with filtering, sorting, and manual tagging options.

screens.name: Export Screen
screens.responsibility: Export filtered and scored highlights in various formats.

design_principles: Clarity: Ensure the interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.
Efficiency: Minimize the number of steps required to identify and export highlights.
Customization: Allow users to tailor the scoring and filtering criteria to their needs.

user_flows.name: Export Highlights
steps: Download or share the highlight list.

frontend.reason: Provides a flexible and scalable foundation for building a dynamic GUI.

backend.reason: Lightweight and efficient for handling data processing and API integration.

machine_learning.reason: Enables in-browser machine learning for highlight detection without requiring server-side processing.

data_storage.reason: Simplifies initial implementation and can be upgraded to a database later.

test_strategy.responsibility: Test individual components and functions for correctness.

examples: Verify data flow from import to highlight detection and export.

test_strategy.responsibility: Gather feedback on usability and functionality.
examples: Test with streamers and editors to validate workflows.

test_strategy.responsibility: Ensure the application meets performance benchmarks.
examples: Measure processing time for a 1-hour stream.

acceptance_criteria: The application must run locally from `index.html` using `python -m http.server`.
Users must be able to import JSON data via FileReader or a textarea input.
The app must implement a scoring function and sort detected items by score in descending order.
Filter controls must be visible and functional for fields like streamer, game, category, and score.
Users must be able to manually mark highlights, which should append to the dataset and rerender results.
Export functionality must use Blob, URL.createObjectURL, and anchor download for filtered results.
Working data must persist locally using localStorage and reload on page load.
Domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp, time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score must be utilized.
